items.name: Rakazo
items.tagline: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own
items.description: Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile.

items.name: Frevana Multiplayer
items.tagline: AI that grows your business alongside your team
items.description: Frevana runs AI agent apps that find customers, create content, and automate busywork. Now it's multiplayer: invite your team with a link, share agents and skills, and build on each other's work. Your best workflow becomes everyone's.

items.name: Tulvo
items.tagline: Smart & adaptive workspace to manage all your work
items.description: Most small businesses run on 10 or more apps that never share data. Docs in one place, tasks in another, customers in a spreadsheet, forms and the website somewhere else. Tulvo puts all of it on one set of connected data. Describe your business in a sentence and Tulvo AI sets up the databases, boards, docs and reports for it. Bring in data from forms and webhooks, automate work, connect your own AI through MCP and host live sites. Try for free for 30 days and grab 50% OFF during Black Friday.

items.name: Talyn
items.tagline: Run Claude Code and Codex in parallel cloud sandboxes
items.description: Talyn runs Claude Code and Codex in parallel cloud sandboxes, on the plan you already pay for. Close the laptop and come back to a diff, or to a pull request that is already green. Free with 10 box-hours a month. For GitHub, on macOS, Windows, Linux, or the browser.

items.name: HuntMonitor
items.tagline: Watch today's hunt live: points, speed, rank moves
items.description: HuntMonitor is a live dashboard for today's Product Hunt race. Sort by points, comments, upvote speed, or hunter. Keep one tab open to see if a launch is climbing or slipping. Open any row for the day's points chart. Updates live, snapshots every 15 minutes.

items.name: Canvas by AgentGrid.io
items.tagline: Agentic Design Canvas - A visual way to collaborate with AI
items.description: Agentic Canvas by AgentGrid.io is a free, agent-first design tool where humans and AI agents work together on real HTML. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Cursor, Codex, or any MCP-compatible agent. Design visually, edit by hand, and let AI pick up where you left off. Free, local, no signup required.

items.name: TwoBucket
items.tagline: Beginner-friendly mobile detailing software for bookings
items.description: TwoBucket is beginner-friendly mobile detailing software for solo detailers and small teams. Customers send their vehicle, its condition and photos from your booking page or website. You send a quote they approve online, then an invoice they pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay into your own Stripe or Square account, with deposits and tips. Visits sync to Google Calendar or iCloud. iPhone, Android and web, or ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or Muse. $20/month, 7-day free trial.

items.name: Perit Marketplace
items.tagline: Sell your data and RL tasks to frontier AI labs
items.description: Perit Marketplace turns your data and expertise into training work for frontier AI labs. Two ways in: submit data you own (audio, video, code, docs, CAD and more; 29 datasets listed so far), or build RL tasks and benchmarks on our platform using our VMs and model credits. We pitch them to labs, and approved experts scale to hundreds of tasks a week. Built by Perit (YC F26), now past $11M in revenue in 4.5 months.

items.name: Remindly
items.tagline: Notes that remind you, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and web
items.description: Remindly is a fast notes app where any note can carry a reminder: one-time, repeating, all-day, or when you arrive somewhere. Capture by typing, voice, scan, or the web clipper. Syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac and web. Imports your Evernote library.

items.name: Spiik
items.tagline: AI note taker for meetings & lectures. No bot on your calls.
items.description: Spiik records meetings, lectures, interviews and calls, then gives you a transcript you can trust: it copes with accents and noisy rooms, labels who said what, and translates into 100+ languages. On a Mac it records Zoom, Meet and Teams with no bot joining the call. From there, get structured notes, quizzes and flashcards, or ask the recording a question. iPhone, iPad and Mac.

items.name: Polylane for Security
items.tagline: Catch exploitable vulnerabilities before they ship
items.description: Polylane reviews production-bound pull requests for exploitable security flaws. Findings trace attacker-controlled input to the vulnerable line, with the evidence and suggested fix. Safe candidates are ruled out with a reason. Daily dependency scans find known CVEs, prioritise the most severe and open fix pull requests on active, deployed repositories.

items.name: ByteAsk Cloud Agents
items.tagline: Find the fix in big codebases. Ship it from Slack.
items.description: ByteAsk gives Claude Code and Codex an index of your whole repo, so they start in the right file. Its Cloud Agent takes bugs from Slack, Jira or the browser, builds and tests in a sandbox, and opens a draft PR. Start with $50 of credit, no card.

items.name: Pixel Office
items.tagline: Run a team of AI agents from a pixel-art office
items.description: Most agent tools are a chat box. Pixel Office is a place: each employee is a real AI agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini or OpenRouter) with its own role, memory, skills and permission level. See at a glance who is working, who needs your approval and who is done. Hire in a character creator, hand out tasks on a board, let agents message each other, and decorate the office with coins from finished work. Open source, one command, runs on your machine with your own keys.

items.name: GotEmail
items.tagline: Fast, native and smart email for Mac and iPhone
items.description: GotEmail is a native mail app for Mac and iPhone. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP account in one fast inbox, with a Smart Inbox that sorts out what matters, AI drafts, summaries and an assistant that knows your mail, one-click sign-in codes, snooze, send later, undo send, read receipts, labels and smart folders. No ads, no account of ours: your mail goes straight between your device and your provider. One license covers every Mac and the iPhone app.

items.name: Privacyboard
items.description: Enter your website: Privacyboard detects your tools and drafts your privacy policy, cookie banner, records and DPA in minutes. Vendors are watched daily, deadlines tracked, and your AI assistant can fill in the rest. Free plan, data in the EU.

items.name: collecto.rs
items.tagline: Catalog any collection, from Pokémon to pitcher plants
items.description: Every collector has their thing. Most of us have five. collecto.rs brings every collection together in one home worth showing off. Snap a photo and it fills in the details. Point it at a TCG binder page and it names every card at once. Pick from 14M+ items across 60+ collection types (cards, vinyl, LEGO, coins, plants and more), or describe your own and we'll set it up. Track collection value, keep a wishlist that spots deals and easily share with friends. Free on iPhone, iPhone Duo and web.

items.name: Emayler
items.tagline: Custom email on your domain, minus the headache
items.description: Business email, without the business email pricing. Emayler gives you real, ad-free mailboxes on your own domain, without charging per user. Create separate inboxes for your team, add unlimited aliases like hello@ and billing@, and manage everything from one dashboard. One account, one flat price. Start free, with paid plans from just $3/month.
